observations.title: SSRF Guard Upstream HTTPS Requirement
observations.narrative: Non-loopback upstreams strictly require HTTPS; loopback HTTP is allowed only for registered local service backends (llama-server, unsloth); other HTTP is dev-mode only (LOCAL_ROUTER_DEV=true)

observations.title: Thinking Level Resolution Order
observations.narrative: Thinking level defaults to medium (DEFAULT_THINKING_LEVEL in src/reasoning.ts). Resolution order: (1) explicit opt-out disables unconditionally, (2) explicit opt-in passes through normalized, (3) configured global/per-provider level applies.

observations.title: Graceful Cascade on Preflight Failures
observations.narrative: Preflight failures (unknown model, no provider, no key/credits, allowlist reject) log skipped: true, stageAttempts: 0 and advance immediately to the next fallback stage without burning retry timeouts. The chain only fails on total cascade exhaustion.
facts: Decision: Graceful Cascade on Preflight Failures
